newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BEBETO TO GO BACK TO BRAZIL FOR $4.1 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BEBETO TO GO BACK TO BRAZIL FOR $4.1 MILLION.

text.p: World Cup striker Bebeto is set to move to Brazilian club Vitoria de Bahia for $4.1 million just two months after joining Sevilla.
"He's going for two reasons, sporting and financial," said Sevilla director-general Herminio Mendez on Saturday.
Bebeto has not scored since arriving at Sevilla, who are immersed in boardroom conflict and are struggling to avoid relegation.
